reviews.x: Very good match for my Philips product, it seems to me that there is no difference with the Philips brand replacement.

These replacement heads are almost exactly the same as the original Philips one. Each one comes individually packaged. The brush head is made of good quality plastic and the bristles are of good quality as well. These are a bargain compared to the original Philips replacement ones.
Compare to the many other toothbrush heads that cost around twice as much ,these get the job done if not better, good product ！

Brushes for the old, but perfectly good, base I have are both expensive and now hard to find. I am glad I took a chance on these. Worries that they were going to be clearly inferior to the name brand proved unwarranted. These work perfectly at a fraction of the cost.

These toothbrush heads fit the Sonicare Essence series 1 well. The shape of toothbrush head looks the same as the Philips one that I am currently using. It is soft for cleaning teeth. I got 6 of them in one pack that cost less money than other.

I was reluctant to buy these since I’ve purchased other knock offs of the sonic care heads, and they weren’t as good as the brand name. But these are every bit as good or better! Much more affordable and they aren’t noisy like the others I tried. The other brands didn’t seem to hold up as long either. These are now my go to brand, super happy to find these. Will definitely buy again and tell all my friends who also think $10 a head is too much to pay especially when everyone in the household use

reviews.t: seem as good as the original
reviews.x: May be too early to tell, but so far these work great. The price was so good, I bought another package hoping to beat the price raise.  One week and the price went up by more than a dollar. Still a good price when compared to the Sonicare original replacement brushes, so I did  buy another package. I should be in good shape now for a while., since my wife and I have a total of 12 replacement brushes. 2 of them have been used now for a month and I still like them.

I have written another review for a different company of this same model replacement head toothbrush with attached video. Long review short, these are much better. The bristles are barely more firm, but that is good, I actually feel like my teeth are being brushed. The heads fit correctly and don't make excessive noise. I have not seen a 1-2 bad replacement heads per 6-pack. I do feel they last the full 12 weeks.  If you require this model replacement head then this is what you want. Better pack

reviews.t: Totally compatible replacement for original brush heads
reviews.x: These replacement brush heads come in sensible packaging and fit the Philips Sonicare e-series toothbrush perfectly.  They look and work just like the originals and their price is very competitive with the various other replacement brush head models for this toothbrush.

This is an excellent replacement.  We ordinarily get these from Costco, but since covid we’ve not gone to stores. Pros:  Exact match to name brand Cons:  Don’t know much as it’s generic without information on box as to origin.  Would recommend and buy again.

Used these in my sonic care and it ruined the motorized portion. Beware when you are using generic. Will have to buy a new charging toothbrush handle now. Also, they don’t last as long and easily fray.
They work fine but definitely not as well as the Panasonic brand. Loses a lot of the power and has much less movement but loss of quality is equal to the price.

reviews.t: These have a tendency to crack.
reviews.x: All six of these tooth brush heads cracked and the bristles fell out in my mouth. They then snapped off the base.
These head’s are WEAK - less than 25% the sonic power of ‘true’ Sonicare heads - DON’T WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!
Works good for its value, can't tell the difference between the original.

reviews.t: No good reason to spend more
reviews.x: An electric toothbrush was a commitment when I bought my first Sonicare toothbrush.  I was using a new dentist and his patients only used Sonicare.  At the time, a single brush and charger were around $125-$150.  I'm on my second Sonicare in just over 20 years.  The brushes were roughly $40 for six on sale at Costco.  The Sonicare brushes last about 2 months.  $40 / year is not a lot to spend,  Then, with one brush left and no Costco sale in sight, I took to Amazon.  I tried three different gene

reviews.t: Most of the brushes failed in two to three days
reviews.x: I got the factory rejects. Almost every single one of the brush heads failed within 2-3 days. Failure seemed to occurr at start up after a few on-off cycles. I think there must be an overshoot of the vibrator during start up. The vibration mechanism of the brush section is a thin metal piece that is attached to magnets and it seems to separate after a few operations.

I was impressed with the brushes' quality considering their price. Most of the brushes heads worked perfectly. (Only one brush head gave me trouble. Something in the head started making noise and made the head vibrate weaker 2 weeks in. It wasn't that big of an issue though because I replaced it with one of the other ones.)

I have been using these replacement brush heads for about a month.  They are just as good, it not better, than the Sonicare replacement brush heads...at a fraction of the price.  I will stick to these replacement brush heads in the future, as opposed to the grossly overpriced Sonicare replacement brush heads.

I have purchased non Philips heads before and returned them because of the noise. The first thing I did was put one of these on the base and try it out. Yay...As quiet as the original and the stiffness seems comparable. I have no idea on the longevity, but for now I am very pleased....Thank you, Rick Burnham

The toothbrush heads arrived promptly, appear to be good quality, fit my Sonicare handle perfectly, and worked well during brushing.  I would give five stars, but since this is my first purchase of this item, I am in no position to say how they will hold up after several weeks of brushing.  So four stars.

Was looking for a cheaper alternative, for the same quality of the name brand, and these do not disappoint.  Fit perfectly on my Series-E toothbrush and  do a great job.  As far as I can tell, it does as good of a job as the name brand and will definitely buy again when the need arises.

reviews.t: They do not vibrate as fast or hard as other brands I have tried
reviews.x: These look really nice, but they just don't vibrate as strongly.  I did not feel like my teeth were clean like I normally do.  Battery was charged and all.  If I switch to another type of knock off brand I've tried, or the OEM materials, then it works properly.  I will not re-buy these

Sonicare wants you to throw away your old E-series toothbrush bases for some fancy high-tech looking new ones with expensive new brushes that aren't compatible with the old E-series bases. Don't do it! These fit and work great. Keep up the good work Jibitee!

Absolutely wonderful product great price and it’s just like the heads we got with the sonicare. great value very nicely packaged! I will definitely buy these again and they have an indicator that tells you when you need to replace them which is very cool.

claims.text: Most reviewers find these replacement heads fit and perform like the original brand, often at a much lower price.
Several reviewers highlight the strong value and affordability compared to name-brand replacements.
A few reviewers report durability problems, including cracking, fraying, and bristles falling out.
Some reviewers say the heads are weaker or lose power compared to the original brand.
One reviewer reports the heads damaged their toothbrush handle.
